data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘an-Nabat’, meaning a gentle breeze or soft wind. In Islamic tradition, the name symbolizes the soothing comfort and peace that comes with the arrival of a newborn. The name Nabaahat carries the meaning “Gentle Breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nabaahat usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Through this name, parents can also pray that their child grows to be a calming influence in the world, with a gentle and compassionate heart.
